sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Glitch Guy Gravity Run is a game about mastering the art of gravity. By switching between different gravitational forces, you'll be able to propel yourself through the level with ease, exploiting the environment to your advantage as you go. The game's controls are refreshingly simple, with a single button used to switch between the three available gravitational forces: normal gravity, reverse gravity, and a special "glitch" mode that allows you to bounce off walls and ceilings.

As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter a variety of obstacles, from moving platforms to spinning blades and treacherous pits of doom. Each obstacle requires a unique approach, and mastering the art of gravitational manipulation is key to success. By carefully timing your gravity switches and combining them with the game's physics engine, you'll be able to navigate even the most treacherous levels with ease.

One of the most appealing aspects of Glitch Guy Gravity Run is its sense of progression. As you complete levels and earn rewards, you'll unlock new gravitational forces, special powers, and even new levels to play through. This sense of progression is expertly balanced, with each new ability or power-up introducing fresh challenges and opportunities for exploration.

In addition to its core gameplay mechanics, Glitch Guy Gravity Run also features a variety of special features and power-ups. These include speed boosts, shields, and even a "slow-motion" mode that allows you to carefully time your gravity switches and navigate through treacherous sections with ease. By mastering these special features and combining them with the game's core mechanics, you'll be able to tackle even the most challenging levels with confidence.
